review_notes: Independently read the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, fact-dispositions.json and link-dispositions.json, rather than treating the prior-result packet as the proposal under review.

The sole proposed write is supported. CargoJump supplies start=0, speed=1 and blend=0; fighter.c initially computes cur_anim_frame=start-speed and, where animation setup occurs, substitutes animation metadata for a zero blend argument. The proposal correctly avoids equating the argument with guaranteed zero effective blending.

The proposed victim synchronization qualification is correct: ftCo_8009C5A4 skips its body when both the requested and current motion are ShoulderedWait. The CargoKneebend caller checks mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y before decrementing it, including decrement after the entry call.

The active Donkey motion table, ordinary jump helper, cargo input callers, throw selector, shouldered helper and cargo landing path support the action-family relationships. Collision delegation is not a local transition into CargoFall.

The proposal contains no unowned writes, new links, entities, merges or follow-ups. Acceptance does not establish the section, compiled layout, ABI, scheduler-wide or persistent-object lifetime claims explicitly deferred below.

Retained high-level victim-update wording denotes synchronization, not mandatory reset. Retained first-invocation physics wording describes this callback's gate, not suspension of all engine movement.
